Their site has no SVG artwork (see notes in ASSETS.md); this is our own trace of their PNG, made 2026-10-25 with potracer 0.0.4 (turdsize 4, alphamax 1.0, opticurve on). Checked by rasterising it in Chromium at the source size and comparing with the source alpha mask: IoU 0.9954. Fine detail is softened, most on hairlines. Use it for crisp scaling and recolouring in the prototype, and ask SAAVEDRA for their real vector files before anything goes live.
